title: A licensee may not process, dispense or administer in a manner intended to circumvent pharmacy law
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(2), a licensee may not process a prescription; dispense a drug, device, or other substance; or administer a controlled substance or vaccine in a manner which is intended, either directly or indirectly, to circumvent any law or regulation governing the practice of pharmacy.
exam_relevance: Tests the three acts 247 CMR 9.01(2) names, its object of any law or regulation governing the practice of pharmacy, and its words intended, either directly or indirectly.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The law or regulation the manner is intended to circumvent is any law or regulation governing the practice of pharmacy, not only a Board regulation.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
